seed.title: EPIDERMOLYSIS BULLOSA SIMPLEX 7, WITH NEPHROPATHY AND DEAFNESS
alt_titles: NEPHROPATHY WITH PRETIBIAL EPIDERMOLYSIS BULLOSA AND DEAFNESS

as_reported: single nucleotide insertion (G383) in exon 5 of CD151

records.label: Two siblings
quotes: Occurrence of hereditary nephritis, pretibial epidermolysis bullosa and beta-thalassemia minor in two siblings with end-stage renal disease.

records.label: Affected sibs

variants.as_reported: single nucleotide insertion (G383) in exon 5 of CD151

quotes: We examined CD151 in 3 MER2-negative patients (2 are sibs) of Indian Jewish origin with end-stage kidney disease.
In addition to hereditary nephritis the sibs have sensorineural deafness, pretibial epidermolysis bullosa, and beta-thalassemia minor.
The 3 patients are homozygous for a single nucleotide insertion (G383) in exon 5 of CD151, causing a frameshift and premature stop signal at codon 140.

notes.statement: In a consensus expert review, Has et al. (2020) reclassified inherited epidermolysis bullosa (EB) using new clinical and molecular data. They introduced the concept of genetic disorders with skin fragility, with classical EB as the prototype. They placed peeling skin disorders, erosive disorders, hyperkeratotic disorders and connective tissue disorders with skin fragility in separate categories under the EB umbrella.
quotes: In this latest consensus report, we introduce the concept of genetic disorders with skin fragility, of which classical EB represents the prototype.
These include peeling skin disorders, erosive disorders, hyperkeratotic disorders, and connective tissue disorders with skin fragility.

notes.statement: Karamatic Crew et al. (2004) showed that CD151 expresses the MER2 blood group antigen and is located on erythrocytes, making it the first tetraspanin detected on red cells.
quotes: We show that CD151 expresses the MER2 blood group antigen and is located on erythrocytes.

notes.statement: Karamatic Crew et al. (2004) found that the 1-nucleotide insertion in exon 5 of CD151 caused a frameshift and premature stop at codon 140, predicted to produce a truncated protein lacking the integrin-binding domain. They concluded that CD151 is essential for proper assembly of glomerular and tubular basement membranes in kidney, has functional significance in skin, is probably a component of the inner ear, and could play a role in erythropoiesis.
quotes: The resultant truncated protein would lack its integrin-binding domain.

We conclude that CD151 is essential for the proper assembly of the glomerular and tubular basement membrane in kidney, has functional significance in the skin, is probably a component of the inner ear, and could play a role in erythropoiesis.
